title: Rain-City Walk | Gait Clock, Depth Landmarks and Continuous Scale
title_zh: 雨城行进｜孤身步态、纵深地标与持续跟随压迫
mechanism: 让同一成年战士保持一个持续前进目标，镜头在正面、侧后和低位跟随间平稳接力；路面反光、无人机和高楼逐级扩大城市尺度，人物步态是全片时钟。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 让同一成年战士保持一个持续前进目标，镜头在正面、侧后和低位跟随间平稳接力；路面反光、无人机和高楼逐级扩大城市尺度，人物步态是全片时钟。 必须满足：一个明显成年主体和一条路线持续存在。；行走节奏记录每次镜头切换。；环境层增加规模而不重置空间关系。；没有未观察到的胜利或战斗被发明。；最终阈值明显连接到开启目的地。。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 一个明显成年主体和一条路线持续存在。
行走节奏记录每次镜头切换。
没有未观察到的胜利或战斗被发明。
最终阈值明显连接到开启目的地。

title: Monastery Skate Route | Steps, Prayer-Wheel Corridor and Courtyard Jump
title_zh: 寺院滑板闯阵｜阶梯落差、转经筒长廊与庭院腾跃
mechanism: 同一成年滑手以黑色长袍、红帽和固定滑板为身份锚点，从壁画阶梯下滑，贴近轮组进入转经筒长廊，再穿入庭院完成一次腾跃；终局停在佛画前，完整路线连续可追踪。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 同一成年滑手以黑色长袍、红帽和固定滑板为身份锚点，从壁画阶梯下滑，贴近轮组进入转经筒长廊，再穿入庭院完成一次腾跃；终局停在佛画前，完整路线连续可追踪。 必须满足：One clearly adult rider, board and costume persist. + The route advances continuously through three zones. + Wheel contact proves traversal. + Exactly one jump occurs with visible landing. + The final stop preserves rider, board and destination.。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 一个明显成年骑手、板子和服装持续存在。
路线连续通过三个区域。
恰好发生一次跳跃，且有可见的着陆。
最终站保留了骑行者、板子和目的地。

title: Carrier Escalation | Continuous Motion Rises from Ground to Sky
title_zh: 连续载具升级｜滑行、冲浪、生物接力到高空释放
mechanism: Keep one original clearly adult protagonist moving continuously along one established direction. Use at least four locomotion states whose carrier, contact surface or scale changes, but require every change to occur at a visible physical threshold and inherit the previous velocity, body posture or wake. Escalate monotonically from ground contact to water surface, larger living or mechanical support, and finally incre
mechanism_zh: 同一明确成年主体沿一个前进方向连续移动，每次只在速度、表面或高度达到阈值后，把运动完整交给下一种原创载具或伙伴；身份、方向和动量不重置。由地面、浪面、生物背部逐级升高，最后用高空释放兑现升级。 必须满足：同一明确成年原创主体、至少三项身份锚点与单一前进方向先建立 + 至少四种移动状态都在可见边缘、接触、尾迹或发射阈值发生交接 + 每次至少继承速度、姿态或尾迹之一 + 接触表面、载体尺度或高度单调升级 + 终局同一成年人在最高层级完成短促空中释放。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 在第一次交接前，锁定一个明显的成年原始身份和一个前进方向。
在可见的物理阈值处触发每个载体的变化，例如边缘、尾迹、接触或发射。
单调地在至少四个状态中增加表面、载体规模或高度。
以最高尺度或高度释放相同的成年人轮廓结束。

title: Two-Wave Airstrike Loop | Overhead Battle and Return Salvo
title_zh: 俯视战场双波打击｜密集基线、空投冲击与回程齐射
mechanism: A coastal fleet uses a smoke-screen opening and return-route flare convergence. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 在持续俯视的策略战场中先建立大规模单位、阵地和固定目标，再用第一波空中投放制造局部缺口；镜头保留同一空间关系关系，第二波飞行单位沿回程路线齐射并留下更大范围余波。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 一种连续的头顶空间关系在攻击前确定目标、编队和结构。
第一次打击改变局部路线或防御状态，而不是起到装饰作用。
第二条可区分的路线或武器模式以更大的镜头覆盖重新访问相同的目标。
终点站保留了原始地图上的幸存单位、损坏的目标和持久的后果。

title: Pursuit Recovery Arc | Continuous Route, Exhaustion Fall, Determined Rise
title_zh: 触手追逐恢复弧｜连续路线、力竭跌倒与决心复起
mechanism: A greenhouse messenger escapes giant roots, falls after a turn and visibly recovers. Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 让同一成年角色沿一条可追踪巷道持续逃离巨型威胁，障碍逐步逼近而路线地标不丢；人物到转角后因力竭倒地，再用呼吸和眼神完成恢复。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 一名身份锁定的成年人遵循一条连续的路线。
重复的地标保留了追踪空间关系。
跌倒发生在可见的障碍物切换之后。
呼吸、支撑和凝视明显证明康复。

title: Screen-in-Screen Montage | Continuous Outer Take, Changing Inner Display
title_zh: 屏中蒙太奇｜外层连续内屏切换
mechanism: Establish one physical display carrier in a continuous outer shot, keep its bezel, operator contact and surrounding geography visibly stable, and confine every montage cut or state change to the inner screen. Use independent outer-layer parallax or occlusion to keep proving that the exterior take has not cut, then finish by bringing the inner result and the persistent outer context into one readable held relationship
mechanism_zh: 在一个连续的外层镜头中建立实体显示载体，保持边框、操作者接触和周围空间关系清楚且稳定，并把所有蒙太奇剪辑或状态变化限制在内屏。利用外层独立的视差或遮挡持续证明外部镜头未切换，最后让内屏结果、实体载体与持续存在的外部环境在同一画面中清楚成立。
anchors: 引入一个实体显示载体，清楚区分内屏画面与外部现实。
保持外层镜头连续，并让设备、操作者接触与环境锚点稳定可见。
在显示边界始终完整的前提下，累积至少三种可区分的内屏状态。
结尾让内屏结果、实体载体与外部环境同时清楚可读。

title: Continuous Retreat Scale Reveal | Moving Anchor and Expanding Hazard
title_zh: 连续拉远尺度揭危｜小型载体、扩张暗区与临界停留
mechanism: Establish one original small moving carrier with a readable heading, speed cue and trail before an environmental anomaly is legible. Use one continuous camera retreat and elevation change with no reveal cut, keeping the carrier and anomaly in the same coordinate relationship as more environment enters the frame. Let the anomaly evolve from an ambiguous dark or geometric texture into a coherent hazard that occupies pr
mechanism_zh: 在环境异常尚未清楚可辨前，先建立一个原创小型移动载体，并让其方向、速度线索和运动轨迹保持可读。全程只使用一次连续的摄影机后退与升高，不得通过切镜揭示；随着更多环境进入画面，载体与异常始终保持相同坐标关系。让异常从模糊的暗色或几何纹理逐步演变成结构清楚、占据越来越多画幅的危险，同时让载体继续作为稳定尺度单位。最后停在撞击前或越过临界点前，载体不得消失。可复用机制是移动尺度锚点、不间断扩展环境上下文、从模糊到危险的揭示和临界距离停留，而不是来源作品中的木船、船帆、海洋、漩涡、奥德赛声明、准确摄影路线、水体物理、配色、水印、创作者身份或时间安排。
anchors: 在异常变得清楚前，先建立一个带有方向、速度线索和轨迹的小型移动载体。
使用一次不中断的摄影机后退与升高，全程不通过切镜揭示。
让异常从模糊纹理成长为占据更多画幅的清楚危险。
在撞击或消失前停留，并保持载体可读。

title: Craft-Play Role Conflict | Collateral Prop Collapse and Reconciliation
title_zh: 手作角色扮演｜分工亮相、道具误伤与集体和解
mechanism: Begin with an original group of clearly adult collaborators jointly making or arranging one lightweight communal prop. Assign playful opposing roles through replaceable costume or wearable-device signals, then keep one visibly fragile shared object inside the confrontation geography before contact occurs. Let one overcommitted performance gesture cause that object to collapse, hold a collective pause long enough to r
mechanism_zh: 先让一组原创且明确成年的协作者共同制作或摆放一个轻质公共道具。通过可替换的服装或可穿戴装置信号分配玩闹的对立角色，并在接触发生前，让一个明显脆弱的共享物始终位于冲突空间内。一次过度投入的表演动作使该物体坍塌，集体停顿要足够长，让所有人确认这个意外结果；最后只有在每个人都退出角色，并修复、聚拢于或平静共享这个已经改变的空间后才能结束。可复用机制是合作基线、角色分裂、可见的附带风险、意外后果和群体和解，而不是来源作品中的熊猫、面孔、服装、纸箱、风车、竹子或木棍塔、后院、准确动作编排、机位、动画处理、Dreamina 品牌、创作者身份或时间安排。
anchors: 角色分裂前，展示所有协作者共同制作或摆放一个公共道具。
通过清楚但可替换的服装或可穿戴装置信号，分配对立的玩闹角色。
把一次过度投入的动作直接连接到物体坍塌，并保留集体反应。
在所有人退出角色并共同修复或共享改变后的空间后结束。

title: Painted Wonder | Tiny Light Becomes Reality
title_zh: 画中物成真｜小光点变奇观
mechanism: Begin with a small mark being intentionally created on a bounded physical surface. Let it acquire autonomy before crossing the surface edge, preserve one continuous trajectory into the live environment, then multiply or scale until its emitted property changes the surrounding world. Creation, autonomy, crossing, multiplication and environmental consequence must occur in that order; medium, creature, setting, emission
mechanism_zh: 先在边界清楚的物理表面上有意创作一个小标记。让它在越过承载表面边缘前获得自主性，并以一条连续轨迹进入现实环境；随后让它倍增或放大，直至它释放出的特性改变周围世界。创作、自主、越界、倍增和环境后果必须依次发生；媒介、生物、场景、释放特性、尺度和情绪均可替换。
anchors: 起点明确是被创作的标记
先出现自主动作
必须跨过真实边界
扩张后改变环境而非只放大

title: Cross-Medium Travel Partners | Landmark Chapters and Synchronized Route
title_zh: 跨媒介旅伴路线｜地标换章、同步动作与共同终姿
mechanism: 固定一名成年真人和一名成年二维原创旅伴，两者保持不同材质却共享方向、节拍与地标路线；每章由一次同步手势或步态证明同场，最终以共同动作结束而非互相替换。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 固定一名成年真人和一名成年二维原创旅伴，两者保持不同材质却共享方向、节拍与地标路线；每章由一次同步手势或步态证明同场，最终以共同动作结束而非互相替换。 必须满足：One clearly adult live-action identity and one clearly adult illustrated identity retain different media signatures throughout. + Every location change preserves paired travel direction and follows a visible shared transition carrier. + Each chapter contains one synchronized action that proves common timing and local geography. + Alterna
anchors: 一个清晰的成人真人身份和一个清晰的成人插图身份始终保留着不同的媒体特征。
每次位置更改都会保留配对的行进方向，并遵循可见的共享过渡载体。
交替前景遮挡证明共享深度，无需合并面部、身体或渲染媒体。
终端框架将两个成年人、一个目的地对象和一个确切的原始路线标题重新组合到一个共享操作中。

title: Contrast Comedy | The Calmer, the More Out of Control
title_zh: 反差喜剧｜越从容越失控
mechanism: Place an impeccably controlled subject inside a rigid public ritual, introduce one initially manageable physical liability, escalate its collateral effects in countable steps, then expose a visible failure while the subject preserves exactly the same confident performance rule. The mismatch between increasing chaos and unchanged poise creates the payoff; casting, setting, hazard, costume, palette and final consequenc
mechanism_zh: 将一个无可挑剔的控制对象置于严格的公共仪式中，引入一种最初可控制的身体负担，以可数的步骤升级其附带影响，然后暴露明显的失败，同时对象保留完全相同的自信表现规则。不断增加的混乱与不变的镇定之间的不匹配创造了收束效果；选角、场景、危险、服装、调色板和最终结果都是可变的。
anchors: 正式场合与沉着主体
负担始终附着主体
至少两次因果连锁
失效可见但主体不慌

title: Delayed-Turn Horror | Silhouette Contamination and Lens Breach
title_zh: 延迟转身惊变｜固定走廊、轮廓污染与贴镜突破
mechanism: 固定走廊中先让成年人物背对镜头保持普通基线，再以一次缓慢转身建立面孔；黑色发丝或烟影从肩部连续扩张，表情和轮廓逐级异变，最终只发生一次贴近镜头的突破。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 固定走廊中先让成年人物背对镜头保持普通基线，再以一次缓慢转身建立面孔；黑色发丝或烟影从肩部连续扩张，表情和轮廓逐级异变，最终只发生一次贴近镜头的突破。 必须满足：One clearly adult identity, one fixed frontal corridor and one back-facing baseline precede all threat cues. + Exactly one complete turn establishes the face before silhouette contamination begins. + The anomalous material grows in continuous registered stages while architecture remains unchanged. + Expression and outline escalate withou
anchors: 一个明显的成人身份、一个固定的正面走廊和一个背面基线位于所有威胁提示之前。
在轮廓污染开始之前，正好一整圈就确定了脸部。
表情和轮廓升级，无需面部替换、身体突变或空间关系重置。
只有一处终端镜头裂口是在克制的握持后以可见接触结束的。

title: Destination Light | Depth Carriers Expand a Stable Exit
title_zh: 纵深载体引导目的光｜稳定结构中逐级扩大出口
mechanism: Establish one enclosed original environment with a single distant destination light on a clear movement axis. Populate at least three depth planes with repeated slow carriers that share a visual family but vary scale and lateral drift. Move the camera continuously toward the same destination while fixed structural ribs, frames or columns pass as parallax and scale evidence. Let carriers intermittently cross the light
mechanism_zh: 在封闭暗空间中先建立唯一远端目的光和一条明确运动轴，让同族慢速载体分布在前中后至少三层纵深，固定建筑肋骨持续证明尺度、方向与位移。摄影机只沿同一轴平稳推进或上升，目的光单调增大并仅被短暂遮挡；终局让光口主导画面，同时在边缘保留结构证明仍是同一空间。可复用的是纵深载体、固定比例参照、单轴进展与目的光释放；不得复制来源水下教堂、具体生物、建筑造型、摄影轨迹、创作者身份或时间。
anchors: 在一个封闭空间内建立一个遥远的目的地灯光和一个明确的运动轴。
将相关的慢速载体放置在至少三个深度平面上，具有不同的视错觉速度。
在载体可能暂时遮挡它的情况下，单调地增长相同的目的地灯光。
当光线主导时结束，但要保留边缘锚点足够长以证明从原始封闭空间的到达。

title: Cloud-Gate Scale Encounter | Human Silhouettes and Near-Contact Hold
title_zh: 云门巨兽逼近｜人类剪影、雾中显形与鼻端停留
mechanism: Astronomers meet a whale-shaped stone machine above clouds. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 用固定崖台与多个人类剪影建立尺度，巨型生物从云层中逐步显出眼睛、鳞片和头部；它只完成一次缓慢靠近并在接触前停下，保留敬畏张力。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 人体比例锚出现在巨型主体前。
巨人逐渐从封闭介质中出现。
相机空间关系位置保持足够稳定以比较比例。
最终的近接触状态在撞击前停止。

title: Drawn-Energy Takeover | Object Morphs, Motion Registration and Room Rewrite
title_zh: 手绘能量接管｜实景载体换形、动作贴合与整屋改写
mechanism: 一条可追踪手绘能量贴合手持实景运动，依次变成浮游生物、织物符号、鱼形与列车轨迹；每次换形都由接触触发，最终从局部线条扩散为整屋星空涂鸦。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 一条可追踪手绘能量贴合手持实景运动，依次变成浮游生物、织物符号、鱼形与列车轨迹；每次换形都由接触触发，最终从局部线条扩散为整屋星空涂鸦。 必须满足：一个连续的手绘载体持续存在。；每种形式的变化都遵循可见接触。；手持相机漂移和绘制动作保持注册。；升级从局部对象扩展到房间尺度。；最终图形世界保留了原创的物理布局。。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 一个连续的手绘载体持续存在。
每种形式的变化都遵循可见接触。
升级从局部对象扩展到房间尺度。
最终图形世界保留了原创的物理布局。

title: Directional Strokes | Action Switches Roles and Builds a Final Mark
title_zh: 动作成字｜方向笔画驱动角色切换与终态标记
mechanism: Let one performer action generate or align with a strong directional stroke, use the landing to convert that stroke into a composition divider, switch to a second performer on the same graphic axis, let the second action bend the stroke into a new geometry, then hold the completed abstract mark as the consequence of both actions.
mechanism_zh: 让第一位表演者的动作生成或对齐一条强方向笔画，落地时把笔画转成构图分隔线；第二位表演者沿同一图形轴进入，用动作把笔画弯成新几何，最后让完成的抽象标记成为两次动作共同造成的结果。
anchors: 将第一个动作绑定到一个主导方向笔画。
使用第一次落地来改变笔画的构图角色。
让第二个动作弯曲或重新配置笔划。
停留展示一个明显继承两次动作的最终标记。

title: Disadvantage Recovery | Ground Escape, Guard, Counter, Radial Clear
title_zh: 弱势反攻清场｜贴地恢复、水盾承压到环形冲击
mechanism: Place one original clearly adult protagonist at a measurable disadvantage inside a ring of adult opponents. The recovery must progress through four distinct but materially continuous ability states: a grounded positional escape, a compact guard that visibly deforms under one close hit, a focused counter that uses the retained material, and one floor-bound radial release that moves opponents outward. Preserve the same
mechanism_zh: 先让明确成年主体处于多人包围的可读弱势，随后用贴地低扫争取站位、近身水盾承受一次冲击，再把同一水体升级为定向水炮与环形冲击；每一级都由前一级状态留下连续水迹，终局以对手倒地和主体平静站立证明清场。 必须满足：明确成年原创主体在非校园环境中面对可测量的环形弱势 + 先用一次贴地动作争取位置 + 紧凑护盾在近身命中下可见变形且双方清楚 + 同一残留介质依次改向为定向反击和贴地环形释放 + 终局主体稳居原中心、对手清楚停在外圈。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 使用明确的成年原版角色，场景在非学校环境中，并建立一个可测量的中心与环之间的劣势。
在任何大型能力之前，先进行一个有根基的位置行动以开始恢复。
使用相同的保留介质进行集中反击和辐射释放。
以对手被向外推移和中心保持不变的成年人冷静结束。

title: Double-support elastic couple｜Controller driven deformation reset
title_zh: 双支座弹性偶｜控制器驱动形变复位
mechanism: Bind two simple graphic characters to two continuously visible physical supports. Change only one measurable support parameter at a time so the pair first demonstrates a shared response, then an asymmetric independent response, then a third materially different relation test. The order, axis and controller may change across instances; character identity and support ownership must remain readable until both supports s
mechanism_zh: 将两个简单的图形角色绑定到两个连续可见的物理支座上。一次仅更改一个可测量的支座参数，以便两个角色先展示共同的响应，再展示不对称的独立响应，最后进行一次显著不同的关系测试。顺序、轴和控制器可能在不同实例中发生变化；角色身份和支座归属关系必须保持可读，直到两座支座稳定到清晰的配对状态。
anchors: 建立两个不同的图形角色，每个角色都明显地绑定到一个稳定的物理支座上。
更改一个可测量的支座参数，并让两个角色通过可读的共享响应进行回答。
应用第三个实质上不同的支座关系或控制器路径，而不重复先前的响应。
让两座支座同步稳定，最终两个清晰可辨的角色仍分别附着在原来的支座一侧。

title: Dual System Collision | Rule Validation
title_zh: 双系统碰撞｜同时证明两种规则
mechanism: Establish two systems separately with distinct color, material physics, motion cadence and starting zones. Alternate equal proof beats while their spatial distance decreases, align them on one readable axis, permit exactly one convergence event, and end on a third shared result that neither system produced alone.
mechanism_zh: 分别建立两个具有不同颜色、材质物理特性、运动节奏和起始区域的系统。当它们的空间距离减小时，交替呈现相等的证明节拍，将它们对齐在一个清晰可辨的轴线上，仅允许一次收敛事件，并以两个系统单独无法产生的第三个共享结果结束。
anchors: 两个系统先独立成立
材质或运动规则明确不同
只发生一次关键汇聚
第三状态同时保留双方证据

title: Upgrade Irony | New Arrival Displaces Old Favorite
title_zh: 升级讽刺｜新物登场旧爱被移走
mechanism: First make an existing object feel sincerely valued, then bind one restrained subject to it through a specific physical attachment. Introduce the upgrade and remove the valued object in the same spatial event so progress and loss are inseparable. Redirect the surrounding group's genuine enthusiasm to the replacement while the attached subject remains visible but unattended. Finish with completely earnest institutiona
mechanism_zh: 先让一个现有物件显得确实备受珍视，再通过明确的实体依附动作，把一个表现克制的主体与它绑定。让升级物进入和珍视物件被移走发生在同一空间事件中，使进步与失去不可分割。把周围群体真诚的热情转向替代品，同时让依附主体仍清楚可见却无人关注。最后以完全真挚的机构式收尾结束，并保留未解决的依附关系，让讽刺来自画面逻辑，而不是眨眼或笑话。
anchors: 先证明旧物被真诚珍爱
用一个具体身体动作锁定依恋
新物进入与旧物移走必须同镜同时发生
群体掌声转向新物且不回应被移走者
结尾保持制度化真诚并保留未解决依恋

title: Repair-and-Recommit Route | Failure Card, Local Fix, Resumed Progress
title_zh: 受挫修复再出发｜失败字卡、局部调整与路线重启
mechanism: A radio maker repairs one coil and resumes a hill test. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先用失败证据与停滞姿态建立低点，再把一次局部维修变成可见转折；能力恢复后必须回到原目标路线，终局以继续前进而非口号证明改变。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 修复之前存在可见的故障状态。
一项有限的干预解决一个局部原因。
同一个成人恢复中断的路线。
最终证明是持续的动作，而不是单独的文本。

title: Emblem World Loop | Enter the Mark, Traverse Its World, Return to Form
title_zh: 标志入境｜穿行世界后回收到原形
mechanism: Open on one compact emblem whose geometry, palette and directional cue become the construction rules of an inhabitable world. Move through at least two spatial proofs, include one readable occupant or functional checkpoint, then perform one large scale change that gathers the world's repeated geometry. Reconstruct the same opening emblem from those visible components and hold it as the terminal state.
mechanism_zh: 打开一个紧凑标志，让其几何、配色和方向成为立体世界的构造规则。通过至少两个空间证明，其中包含一个可辨角色或功能检查点；再进行一次尺度升级，收集世界中重复出现的几何，最终从这些组件重建同一个开场标志。
anchors: 从一个清晰定义几何形状、调色板和方向的紧凑标志开始。
使用其自身组件的重复版本将标志扩展为可导航环境。
使用一个主要的尺度变化将环境收集到一个简化的全局形式中。
通过从可见的世界组件中重建并保持相同的开放徽章来结束。

title: Emotional Purge Conversion | Photo Release, Appraisal Proof and Cash Payoff
title_zh: 情绪物证清空｜低谷表情、旧物处置与价值回报
mechanism: 先用同一成年人物的泪痕和旧照片建立关系低谷，再让她把照片装入一个可追踪袋子、发现可变现物件并完成柜台交易；现金结果必须来自已展示物件，终局情绪由悲伤转为释然。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先用同一成年人物的泪痕和旧照片建立关系低谷，再让她把照片装入一个可追踪袋子、发现可变现物件并完成柜台交易；现金结果必须来自已展示物件，终局情绪由悲伤转为释然。 必须满足：One clearly adult protagonist and one disposal container persist. + The emotional low is evidenced before any solution appears. + The valuable object is visibly discovered and remains traceable through appraisal. + Payment follows a completed inspection and cannot appear from nowhere. + The final relief preserves memory of the preced
anchors: 一个明显成年主角和一个处置容器一直存在。
在任何解决方案出现之前，情感低谷已经显现。
支付在完成检查后进行，不能凭空出现。
最终的减压装置保留了前因后果的记忆。

title: Stage Blocking Rewrite | Spatial Relations Replace Event Lists
title_zh: 机器前潜伏揭示｜遮挡基线、人物逼近与红警反打
mechanism: An archive scanner enters quarantine after a conservator's switch press. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先让大型机器和吊链占据前景，蒙面成年人物从后景逐步靠近并保持低姿态；当手触工作台时，环境从冷蓝突变为红警，机器下反打完成威胁揭示。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 前景中的机械设备建立了基础空间。
一位成年人通过建立的深度层次接近。
警报状态跟随那个动作。
低反向角度揭示了同一个人和一个具体的结果。

title: Ordered Room Completion | Shell, Finish, Furniture, Light
title_zh: 毛坯房顺序完工｜表面施工、木作、家具与照明验收
mechanism: 锁定同一房间几何与机位，装修按墙面、地板、固定木作、家具和灯光的依赖顺序逐层出现；前一阶段必须保持为后一阶段的基础，最终用完整可用空间收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 锁定同一房间几何与机位，装修按墙面、地板、固定木作、家具和灯光的依赖顺序逐层出现；前一阶段必须保持为后一阶段的基础，最终用完整可用空间收束。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 机位和门窗几何固定
先完成固定施工再进家具
终局保留所有前置层级

title: Empty Scene Anomaly | Material Spread and Title Hold
title_zh: 空场异常｜物质扩张与片名停留
mechanism: An ordered empty location and one marked mundane object create a baseline. A single traceable material anomaly spreads in relation to that locus, then the camera holds the changed evidence under a distinct overlaid original title; the material is not assumed to generate the title or to have an unseen exact cause.
mechanism_zh: An ordered empty location and one marked mundane object create a baseline. A single traceable material anomaly spreads in relation to that locus, then the camera holds the changed evidence under a distinct overlaid original title; the material is not assumed to generate the title or to have an unseen exact cause.
anchors: 异常有起点
变化后证据持续存在
标题不被误写成异常产物

title: Companions Release into Light | Group Portrait, Shared Walk, Empty-Scene Proof
title_zh: 同行者升空消散｜静态合影、并肩前进与光翼释放
mechanism: Three lighthouse volunteers become wind forms after a shared pier walk. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先用固定街道和三名成年同行者建立稳定关系，再让三人同步向镜头前进；光翼只在终段增强，人物按同一方向化光离场，空街成为结果证明。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 确立了三个成年人的身份和立场。
小组在一个连续的轴上行走。
每个人都映射到一种离开的光形态。
离开后仍保留原创的环境为证。

title: Market Cat Dyad | Shared Establishment, Crouched Contact and Reaction Split
title_zh: 双人街角微互动｜固定站位、共同蹲下与表情接力
mechanism: 在高密度彩色街角固定两名成年动漫人物、服装差异和左右站位；两人同步蹲下靠近一只猫，再通过视线、遮嘴轻笑和互看完成关系推进，环境与身份始终不切换。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 在高密度彩色街角固定两名成年动漫人物、服装差异和左右站位；两人同步蹲下靠近一只猫，再通过视线、遮嘴轻笑和互看完成关系推进，环境与身份始终不切换。 必须满足：Exactly two clearly adult identities retain left-right order. + One shared animal and one location remain accounted for. + Both subjects enter the lower pose continuously. + The social response passes from one person to the other through visible eye line. + The final close view preserves the same dyad and environmental anchors.。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物
anchors: 确切的两个成年身份保持左右顺序。
一个共享的动物和一个地点仍然被记录。
社交反应通过可见的视线从一个人传递到另一个人。
最终特写保留相同的双人组和环境锚点。

title: Three-Dancer Focus Handoff | Ensemble Establishment, Center Push and Group Return
title_zh: 三人群舞聚焦｜全阵建立、中心逼近与合舞回归
mechanism: 先在反光霓虹舞台建立三人队形，让全员同步动作证明空间关系；镜头连续收紧到中心成年表演者的面部和上身，再后退恢复完整队形与共同终拍。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先在反光霓虹舞台建立三人队形，让全员同步动作证明空间关系；镜头连续收紧到中心成年表演者的面部和上身，再后退恢复完整队形与共同终拍。 必须满足：Exactly three clearly adult performers remain distinct and spatially stable. + The center performer receives focus without deleting or replacing the side partners. + Forward and backward camera travel share one axis and continuous stage geometry. + Group choreography brackets one bounded solo close-up phrase. + The final formation matches the open
anchors: 确切的三个明显成年人保持独立且空间稳定。
中心表演者获得焦点，而不删除或替换侧边伙伴。
群舞编排括号内包含一个有界独白特写短语。
最终队形与开场角色顺序一致，并在一个共享节拍上结束。

title: White-Plain Whale Reveal | Human Scale, Terrain Misread and Giant Passage
title_zh: 白地巨鲸尺度揭示｜微小人物、地貌误读与近体压境
mechanism: 官方原视频实测为 25.067 秒而非候选阶段记录的 17 秒；同一成年人物在白色裂地建立微小尺度，远处地貌逐步显出巨鲸身份，巨体起身掀起尘浪并从人物上方经过。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 官方原视频实测为 25.067 秒而非候选阶段记录的 17 秒；同一成年人物在白色裂地建立微小尺度，远处地貌逐步显出巨鲸身份，巨体起身掀起尘浪并从人物上方经过。 必须满足：One clearly adult subject remains the human scale anchor. + The giant form begins as a plausible terrain feature. + Identity clues are revealed progressively before full scale. + Environmental displacement follows one giant-body action. + The final frame preserves both adult and giant geography without implying injury.。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、
anchors: 一名明显成年的受试者仍然是人类尺度的锚。
巨大的形态一开始是一个合理的地形特征。
一次巨体行动后会发生环境位移。
最后一帧保留了成人和巨人的空间关系特征，但并不意味着受伤。

title: Environment-Interrupted Duel | Shared Disruption and Same-Axis Resumption
title_zh: 环境介入对决｜攻防交换、外力中断与原位复战
mechanism: 先在同一危险环境中建立两名成年对手和可读攻防轴，让风、雨和载体摇摆逐步改变脚步；一次强烈环境事件必须同时打断双方，双方恢复站位后沿原轴继续交锋。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先在同一危险环境中建立两名成年对手和可读攻防轴，让风、雨和载体摇摆逐步改变脚步；一次强烈环境事件必须同时打断双方，双方恢复站位后沿原轴继续交锋。 必须满足：Two clearly adult original opponents, one fixed conflict axis and three environmental anchors establish the duel. + Every attack, evade and block remains readable while environmental force progressively changes balance. + One major external event interrupts both opponents simultaneously and preserves the same geography. + Both adults recove
anchors: 两个明显成年的原始对手、一个固定的冲突轴和三个环境锚定了决斗。
当环境力量逐渐改变平衡时，每次攻击、躲避和格挡都保持可读。
在任何新的攻击开始之前，两个成年人都从可见的中断后位置中恢复过来。
终端交易所回到原创的轴心，悬而未决，没有发明出胜利者。

title: Scanning-Front Depletion | Local Desaturation, Geographic Spread, Limited Recovery
title_zh: 扫描束环境耗竭｜局部变灰、跨景传播与有限回馈
mechanism: A climate drone drains and partially restores one rooftop garden. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 把一个可见扫描束设为状态传播前沿，让彩色生态按相邻区域逐步变灰；范围从花地扩展到森林与水面，终局只恢复一个有限点而非无因重置。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 一个可见的移动前沿会导致每次状态变化。
受影响区域通过邻近空间关系区域扩展。
效应器保持空间注册。
恢复是有限的并且是明显引起的，而不是完全重置。

title: Future Evidence | Anomalies Enter Reality
title_zh: 未来证据｜异常闯入现实
mechanism: A bounded evidence carrier first contradicts a stable live scene, then updates the same spatial variable in two increasingly urgent states before the represented change crosses its boundary into shared reality. Repeated verification, invariant geometry and delayed performance make the transition legible; the carrier, genre, phenomenon, location, camera grammar and emotional payoff remain variable.
mechanism_zh: 一个边界明确的证据载体先与稳定的现实场景基准相矛盾，再以两个愈发紧迫的状态更新同一空间变量，随后让所表现的变化越过载体边界进入共享现实。重复核验、稳定几何和延迟反应使转变清楚可辨；载体、类型、现象、地点、镜头语法和情感收束均可替换。
anchors: 现实基线稳定
同一证据载体至少两次更新
异常先在证据内出现
跨界延迟发生且只有一次克制反应

title: Sample doubling｜After the machine is turned on, it continuously outputs the same group of people
title_zh: 样本倍增｜机器开启后连续输出同类群体
mechanism: Place one unmistakable exemplar beside or on a closed production device and keep both readable. Use one visible trigger, then require the device to expose a separate output threshold before any result appears. Release matching instances one at a time through that same threshold while the exemplar remains unchanged as a comparison anchor. Accumulate the outputs in visible space and finish with exemplar, device, thresh
mechanism_zh: 把一个清楚可辨的样本放在封闭生产设备旁或设备顶部，并始终保持可读。先显示一次可见触发，再让设备在产生任何结果前打开独立输出口。匹配实例从同一输出口逐个出现，原始样本作为对照锚点保持不变。让输出在可见空间中逐步累积，最终把样本、设备、输出口和累积结果同时留在画面中完成验证。
anchors: 在同一个可读框架内建立一个身份样本和一个封闭的生产装置。
使用一个可见的触发器并在第一个结果之前显示明显的输出口开口。
通过同一输出口逐个重复输出，并将它们累积在可见空间中。
将示例、设备、打开的输出口和累积输出放在一起。

title: Garment Assembly Audition | Wireframe Body, Panel Build and Studio Resolution
title_zh: 数字服装装配｜人体线框、裁片贴合与身份完成
mechanism: 先用线框人体和常驻服装设计板建立结构，裁片沿可见路径贴合躯干，再依次恢复材质、肤色与头发；终局离开装配态进入干净人物主视图，证明所有部件属于同一身份。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先用线框人体和常驻服装设计板建立结构，裁片沿可见路径贴合躯干，再依次恢复材质、肤色与头发；终局离开装配态进入干净人物主视图，证明所有部件属于同一身份。 必须满足：One clearly adult body scaffold retains fixed proportions throughout assembly. + Persistent design panels identify the same original garment from start to finish. + Every panel follows a visible attachment path to its intended body region. + Material and identity resolve only after structural fit is complete. + The final full-body pose p
anchors: 一个明显成人的身体支架在组装过程中保持固定的比例。
持久设计面板从头到尾标识同一原始服装。
材料和身份只有在结构契合完成后才能确定。
最终的全身姿态证明了集成的服装、解剖和身份，无需替换。

title: External Blocker Replan | Resource Check to an Accepted Alternative
title_zh: 阻断改道｜资源检查后落入替代活动
mechanism: Establish one ordinary intended action and the environmental condition required to complete it. Introduce one visible external blocker, then show the character checking the specific enabling resource that could overcome it. Confirm that the resource is unavailable through legible physical evidence. Let the character choose a setting-compatible alternative activity, preserve the blocker in the background, and end on a
mechanism_zh: 建立一项普通的预期行动以及完成该行动所需的环境条件。引入一种可见的外部拦截器，然后显示角色检查可以克服它的特定支持资源。通过清晰的物理证据确认资源不可用。让角色选择一个与环境兼容的替代活动，将阻碍者保留在背景中，并以稳定的情感证据结束，证明修改后的计划被真正接受。可重复使用的机制是预期的行动、外部阻碍、资源检查、确认的赤字、选择的替代方案和确定的收束——而不是来源女人、书店、雨、雨伞、咖啡、书籍、服装、窗户布局、确切的性能、创造者身份或模型声明。
anchors: 在阻碍出现之前建立一项预期的行动及其有利的环境条件。
当角色对其进行评估时，保持一个外部阻挡器明显处于活动状态。
在开始与场景兼容的替代活动之前确认资源缺失。
在障碍仍未解决的情况下，以稳定的情绪或行为证据结束。

title: Extraordinary Visitor, Ordinary Day | Mundane Tasks Normalize the Premise
title_zh: 异客日常化｜多项普通任务累积到黄昏返回
mechanism: Open on one unmistakably extraordinary but original visitor at a familiar domestic threshold. Preserve the same identity anchors across a one-way daytime route of at least four visually different mundane responsibilities. Each chapter must contain one familiar tool or exchange, one complete action and one visible result; surrounding people and environments respond normally rather than explaining the visitor. Use obje
mechanism_zh: 先在熟悉的生活门槛处呈现一名一眼可辨、但完全原创的非常规访客。让同一身份锚点沿单向白天路线完成至少四项视觉和职责都不重复的日常任务；每一章都必须包含一种熟悉工具或交换方式、一次完整动作和一个可见结果。周围人物与环境始终把访客当作普通成员，不解释来历，也不以恐慌制造冲突。用物件状态或手部动作连接各段，只发生一次昼夜变化，最后让访客回到开场边界并作出克制回应。可复用的核心是“非常规身份被连续的普通能力和同地返回逐步正常化”；明确排除来源外星人造型、郊区住宅、汽车、服务窗口、饮料、烧烤、美甲、花园、服装、具体任务、机位、创作者身份和原片节奏。
anchors: 在路线开始前，在普通门槛处建立一名原始非凡访客。
在至少四个非重复的平凡任务中保持相同的身份锚。
让世界正常回应，避免解释访客的来源。
使用一个白天到夜晚的过渡并以克制的方式返回到开放边界。

title: Formal-Role Wardrobe Mismatch | Full-Body Reveal and Reminder Close
title_zh: 正式场合反差钩子｜权威基线、服装错位与日常收束
mechanism: A museum guide's outfit mismatch resolves into one preparation reminder. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先用正式空间和受众建立权威基线，再通过一次全身揭示暴露服装反差；人物保持严肃继续，终局切到同一人居家醒来与短句，把笑点转为产品需求。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 正式基线确定角色和受众。
一次全身暴露暴露了有限的不匹配。
平凡的第二个场景解释了需求，但没有发明产品 UI。
一句话就结束了笑话和实用性。

title: Fabric-Light Credits | Continuous Textile Pressure to Master Title
title_zh: 织物光影职员表｜连续载体、球形压痕与字幕接力
mechanism: 只用一条连续可追踪的悬浮织物作为字幕载体，让移动光球、阴影、条纹切片与柔性褶皱依次改变文字的显隐和尺度；每条职员表都绑定一次可见材质变形，最后织物退出黑场而不混入无关画面。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 只用一条连续可追踪的悬浮织物作为字幕载体，让移动光球、阴影、条纹切片与柔性褶皱依次改变文字的显隐和尺度；每条职员表都绑定一次可见材质变形，最后织物退出黑场而不混入无关画面。 必须满足：One continuous flexible carrier remains identifiable from opening through the final title. + Every credit appears only after one visible light, pressure, fold or occlusion event acts on that carrier. + Deformation may distort text transiently but each exact credit must recover to a readable state. + Color and graphic overlays
anchors: 一个连续的灵活载体从打开到最终标题都保持可识别性。
每个积分仅在一次可见光、压力、折叠或遮挡事件作用于该载体后才会出现。
颜色和图形叠加永远不会取代底层布料或引入第二个不相关的场景。
在相同的材料退出为黑色之前，终端标题保留在已释放的载体上。

title: Facial Calibration | Isolated Action Units Under a Fixed Identity
title_zh: 表情校准｜固定身份下的动作单元序列
mechanism: A facial calibration sequence becomes reusable when identity, lighting, background and camera axis stay fixed while distinct facial action units change one group at a time. Brief micro-resets preserve comparability, and a late controlled crop can test fine identity stability without turning the sequence into a narrative performance.
mechanism_zh: 保持身份、光线、背景和镜头轴固定，每次只改变一组面部动作单元。短暂回到中性状态以维持可比性，后段用克制的局部特写检验细节稳定性，但不把校准序列变成叙事表演。
anchors: 在任何表情变化之前锁定一张脸、背景、灯光方向和相机轴。
将表情分成可读的局部单元，而不是连续变形整个脸部。
保持头部运动服从于眼睛、眉毛、嘴巴和脸颊的证据。
只有在身份被反复证明后才使用后期更接近的作物。

title: Object to Inner World | Reveal, Descent, Return Proof
title_zh: 熟悉物件内藏世界｜透明揭示、下潜进入与来源回证
mechanism: 先把普通物件作为尺度基线，再让局部透明揭示内部世界；镜头沿同一开口下潜、在内部完成空间证明，最后用原物件结构回证来源。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先把普通物件作为尺度基线，再让局部透明揭示内部世界；镜头沿同一开口下潜、在内部完成空间证明，最后用原物件结构回证来源。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 先建立普通物件尺度
内部世界从原物件内显出
结尾回证仍在原容器内

title: Fatigue Pose Relay | One Body State Across Locations
title_zh: 疲惫姿态接力｜地点物件承接同一身体状态
mechanism: 锁定同一明确成年人物与疲惫身体状态，让多个地点物件依次成为支撑面；每次换地点都保留服装、包袋和下坠姿态，最终在最意外容器中安静停住。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 锁定同一明确成年人物与疲惫身体状态，让多个地点物件依次成为支撑面；每次换地点都保留服装、包袋和下坠姿态，最终在最意外容器中安静停住。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 服装包袋与人物身份不变
疲惫姿态跨地点连续
支撑物变化不得造成身份替换

title: Morning Training Progression | Preparation, Strength Set, Hydration Exit
title_zh: 晨间训练递进｜准备、力量组、补水与离场兑现
mechanism: A rescue diver completes a dawn readiness circuit and exits toward deployment. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 锁定同一成年人物，以换装、进入、力量动作、短恢复和离场组成可读训练弧；每章只新增一个负荷，终局用步态证明状态改变。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 至少三个成人身份锚保持固定。
准备先于努力。
恢复时间短暂且有利于身体恢复。
出发证明准备就绪，而不是添加新任务。

title: Fiction Dismantled | Anchored Pullback to Set and Monitor Layers
title_zh: 叙事拆幕｜情绪场景连续退到片场与监看层
mechanism: Build one self-contained fictional scene with a stable performer, emotionally legible objective and a practical light or prop anchor. Hold the fiction long enough to earn belief, then let the performer make one small physical approach toward that anchor while the camera begins one continuous retreat. Preserve performer, prop and action as registration anchors while the frame crosses the set boundary and reveals at le
mechanism_zh: 构建一个独立的虚构场景，配备稳定的表演者、情感上清晰的目标以及实用的灯光或道具锚。保持虚构足够长的时间以赢得信任，然后让表演者向锚点稍微靠近一点，同时摄像机开始连续后退。保留表演者、道具和动作作为注册锚点，同时框架跨越设定的边界并显示至少三个制作线索。继续到明显包含原始小说的监控层，然后以一个简短的面向观众的感知问题结束。可重用的机制是信仰、锚定撤退、物质生产揭示、中介递归和判断——而不是源历史剧、中国走廊、绿色服装、灯笼、演员、绿幕布置、监视器、精确的措辞、创作者身份或时间安排。
anchors: 在揭露结构之前，通过一个连贯的虚构场景和情绪清晰的表演者赢得信任。
使用一件实用的道具或灯光以及一项表演者动作作为静修期间的连续注册锚点。
在物理集显示后在监视或捕获层中显示原始虚构图像。
以一个紧凑的面向观众的判断提示结束，没有新的阐述。

title: First-Person Inspection | Occlusion Failure and Resolution
title_zh: 第一视角查岗｜遮挡失效到摆烂收口
mechanism: Keep one embodied first-person observer continuous while a subject attempts several visible concealments. Each intervention must expose a deeper, independently readable contradiction; camera height and proximity change only through the observer's body, and the payoff is a visible turn from active concealment to stopping the concealment and settling back into the workstation state rather than another reveal.
mechanism_zh: 保持一个具身的第一人称观察者连续在场，同时让主体尝试多次可见的遮挡。每次干预都必须暴露一层更深、且可独立读懂的矛盾；摄影机高度与距离只能随观察者的身体运动改变。收束应清楚表现主体从主动遮挡转为停止遮挡，并重新靠回工位姿态，而不是再增加一次揭露。
anchors: 使用一个连续的、具身化的第一人称观察者，其高度和距离的变化来自于物理移动。
要求至少两次隐藏尝试，每次都暴露更深层的矛盾。
从物体证据过渡到持续的面部或身体反应。
以一个可见的行为改变结束，而不是第三次揭示。

title: Lip-Color Testimonial | Product Raise, Single Application and Camera Return
title_zh: 美妆自拍实证｜正脸口播、包装同框与单次涂抹
mechanism: 固定同一成年人物、卧室镜面和竖屏自拍机位；人物先口播，再让盒装与管装产品同时同框，完成一次唇部涂抹，并以产品在手的妆效近景回到结论。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 固定同一成年人物、卧室镜面和竖屏自拍机位；人物先口播，再让盒装与管装产品同时同框，完成一次唇部涂抹，并以产品在手的妆效近景回到结论。 必须满足：One clearly adult host, one room and one product set persist. + Packaging is shown before application. + Only one continuous application gesture occurs. + The applicator returns to its original package. + The final result and product remain visible together.。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 一个明确的成年主持人、一个房间和一个产品套装持续存在。
展示包装在应用之前。
应用器返回到其原始包装。
最终结果和产品一起保持可见。

title: Ordered Garment Layering | Fixed Display Body
title_zh: 固定人台逐层着装｜衣物投送、层级闭合与触感验收
mechanism: 锁定一个无身份人台，衣物按下装、内搭、外套和配件的功能层级依次到位；第一人称双手只负责投送或整理，最终用触摸和全身轮廓证明完成。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 锁定一个无身份人台，衣物按下装、内搭、外套和配件的功能层级依次到位；第一人称双手只负责投送或整理，最终用触摸和全身轮廓证明完成。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 人台比例全程不变
衣物按功能层级到位
终局同时证明轮廓与材质

title: Mechanical Aperture Roster | Individual Roles to Radial Ensemble
title_zh: 机械光圈角色谱系｜单人揭示、职责差异与放射群像
mechanism: 用同一齿轮、管线和机械光圈作为固定角色槽，让多个成年原创人物逐一显露面孔、服装、姿态和职责物；每次只登记一人，终局把全部人物汇入放射式机械名册。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 用同一齿轮、管线和机械光圈作为固定角色槽，让多个成年原创人物逐一显露面孔、服装、姿态和职责物；每次只登记一人，终局把全部人物汇入放射式机械名册。 必须满足：One fixed mechanical aperture, portrait bay, dial and field order remain registered. + Every clearly adult original role changes four comparison fields together: face, silhouette, stance and tool. + The aperture fully closes between identities and cannot hide a partial morph. + One reveal interval contains exactly one adult identity and rea
anchors: 一个固定机械光圈、人像托架、拨盘和场序保持注册状态。
每个明显成人的原创角色都一起改变了四个对比领域：脸、剪影、姿势和工具。
一个揭示区间恰好包含一个成人身份和可读的角色证据。
终端径向名册围绕同一中心机制恢复每个已建立的成人、人数和工具。

title: Fixed Witness Frame | The Outside World Descends by States
title_zh: 固定见证框架世界降级｜车厢不变、窗外状态逐级坠落
mechanism: Lock the camera inside one original moving carrier with a persistent window frame, interior geometry and at least two clearly adult witness identities. Keep the carrier's movement direction and interior continuity stable while the exterior passes through at least four increasingly impossible world states. Let each state become visually legible through the window before witness performance changes, then escalate react
mechanism_zh: 把移动载体内部、窗框、固定摄影机和同一组成年见证者锁成现实锚点，只让窗外世界沿持续运动方向按至少四种可辨识状态顺序降级。每一级先由外部景观清楚证明，人物反应滞后一拍并逐步增强，外部光色和物理变化必须回照同一内舱。终局让载体继续运行，并让不可逆的新世界与原见证者共同保持。可复用的是固定见证框架、外部状态阶梯、景观先行、反应滞后和终态共存；不得复制来源车厢、乘客、灾变景观、准确镜头、创作者身份或时间。
anchors: 将一个摄像头固定在一个移动的载体内，载体有稳定的窗口、内部和至少两个成年人作为见证锚。
在载体方向保持不变的情况下，通过至少四个有序的世界状态仅改变外部。
将外部升级与不变的内部光线溢出结合。
以一个质性上全新的终端世界结束，而见证者仍然在载体内。

title: Flat Avatar World Crossing | Physical Proof and Return
title_zh: 平面角色越界｜桌面基线、实体世界互动与来源回归
mechanism: 先锁定平面界面、角色和图标关系，再让同一角色跨越屏幕边界进入具纵深的实体世界；互动结束后沿可辨路径回归原界面，身份与布局均得到回证。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先锁定平面界面、角色和图标关系，再让同一角色跨越屏幕边界进入具纵深的实体世界；互动结束后沿可辨路径回归原界面，身份与布局均得到回证。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 角色跨媒介身份不变
只通过一个可见边界穿越
返回后界面仅发生有因果的变化

title: Conversation Block Advance | Paired Speakers, Moving Platform and Graphic Return
title_zh: 海报空间重组｜人物层、对话块与品牌页回环
mechanism: 保持同一竖版海报的文字区、人物和红蓝对话块，让人物从平面层获得轻微空间关系；一个对话块前移承担信息转场，随后全部元素归回版式并收束到品牌色页。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 保持同一竖版海报的文字区、人物和红蓝对话块，让人物从平面层获得轻微空间关系；一个对话块前移承担信息转场，随后全部元素归回版式并收束到品牌色页。 必须满足：One persistent poster grid defines every element's home position. + All human figures are clearly adult and remain tied to their original graphic blocks. + Only one speech block leaves the layout to carry the information peak. + The complete poster must visibly reconstruct before the end card. + Exact original title and logo remain readable
anchors: 一个持续的海报网格定义了每个元素的原始位置。
所有人类角色都清楚地成年，并且保持在原始图形块中。
完整的海报必须在片尾卡前明显重建。
精确的原始标题和标志保持可读，并不从源文本中推断。

title: Flat Token to Physical Spill | Performance Recovery
title_zh: 平面物件落地｜打断表演与收拾恢复
mechanism: A performer moves within a stable graphic layout. Her movement sits immediately beside the flat-token-to-physical-prop spill, though the source does not prove one gesture caused it. The sudden fall interrupts the routine; a brief recovery restores performance. The paper-theatre transfer adds an explicit sweep trigger as an original causal enhancement, not a claimed source fact. Preserve boundary crossing and reaction
mechanism_zh: A performer moves within a stable graphic layout. Her movement sits immediately beside the flat-token-to-physical-prop spill, though the source does not prove one gesture caused it. The sudden fall interrupts the routine; a brief recovery restores performance. The paper-theatre transfer adds an explicit sweep trigger as an original causal enhancement, not a claimed source fact. Preserve boundary crossing and reaction
anchors: 先建立稳定平面布局
图形落成实体并打断活动
收拾后回到同一人物动作

title: Flip-Cell Wordmark | Pixel Assembly, Extrusion, Recoil, Card Closure
title_zh: 翻片矩阵字标组装｜像素激活、平面组字、厚度长出与卡片收束
mechanism: Establish one fixed cell matrix, one exact short word and a neutral unflipped baseline. Propagate local cell activation until the complete flat word is readable without misspelling. Grow registered letter depth, layers and one accent while preserving every character position. Use bounded extrusion and recoil so modules return to a stable aligned state. Compress the resolved dimensional word into one clean card and ho
mechanism_zh: 固定翻片矩阵从局部激活扩散成完整单词，平面字形随后长出厚度、分层和少量点色，所有组件保持注册并回弹落稳，最后缩入简洁品牌卡。 必须满足：Establish one fixed cell matrix, one exact short word and a neutral unflipped baseline. + Propagate local cell activation until the complete flat word is readable without misspelling. + Grow registered letter depth, layers and one accent while preserving every character position. + Use bounded extrusion and recoil so modules return to a stable aligne
anchors: 建立一个固定单元矩阵，一个确切的短词和一个中立的未翻转基线。
将局部单元激活传播，直到整个平铺的单词可读且无拼写错误。
使用有界推挤和回缩，使模块返回到稳定对齐的状态。
将解决的尺寸单词压缩成一张干净的卡片，并保持精确的锁定。

title: Flow-Carried Style Escalation | Baseline, Identity Check, Split Convergence
title_zh: 墨烟试装升级｜日常基线、遮挡换装与黑白合流
mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original subject, a readable everyday full-body baseline and one continuously traceable transformation carrier before the first style change. Use each carrier crossing as the visible cause of exactly one declared styling change while preserving face, age, body proportions, pose axis and studio geography. Escalate styling in ordered density levels from practical clothing to tailored and scu
mechanism_zh: 先以日常全身造型建立一名明确成年人物，再让同一条可追踪流体载体反复遮挡并揭示受控造型变化；服装密度从休闲逐级升至礼服，中段用面部近景重新核验身份，结尾让两种载体分支合流为一套清楚的双色英雄造型。 必须满足：Establish one clearly adult original subject, a readable everyday full-body baseline and one continuously traceable transformation carrier before the first style change. + Use each carrier crossing as the visible cause of exactly one declared styling change while preserving face, age, body proportions, pose axis and
anchors: 在第一次风格转变之前建立一个清晰的成人原创主体、一个可读的日常全身基线和一个持续可追溯的转型载体。
使用每个载体交叉作为确切一个声明的造型变化的可见原因，同时保留面部、年龄、身体比例、姿势轴和工作室空间关系。
插入一个有界肖像检查点，在终端全身阶段之前重新验证稳定的身份锚点。
将载体分成两个明显不同的分支，然后将它们重新组合成一个稳定的两部分英雄设计并保存完成的结果。

title: Metric Fold-Down | Total, Detail, Aggregate, Current State
title_zh: 数据折叠｜总量下钻到当前值
mechanism: Open with one oversized total that calibrates scale, unfold into itemized records that prove the claim, refold those records into an aggregate result, pivot through one intermediate milestone to a current-state value, then use one restrained manual annotation to lock the conclusion.
mechanism_zh: 以一个超大总量开场，先校准信息量级；把它展开成能验证主张的逐项记录，再将记录折回为聚合结果；通过一个相关的中间里程碑转向当前状态值，最后只用一次克制的手动标注锁定结论。
anchors: 展示证据前，先用一个占据视觉主导的总量与一个紧凑标签开场。
把总量主张展开为至少两条逐项记录，并让类别区分清楚可见。
切换指标系列前，先把明细记录折回为一个聚合结果。
以当前状态值收尾；只有在数值清楚可读后，才加入一次克制标注。

title: Micro-Gesture Global Rewrite | Trigger, Distributed Disruption, Calm Passage
title_zh: 微动作改写全场｜指尖触发、分布失衡与冷静穿行
mechanism: A greenhouse inspector triggers a bench-by-bench water-pressure wave with one counter tap. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先建立正常人群流动，再让中心人物一个小而明确的手势成为唯一触发；环境中的多人和纸张按传播顺序失衡，触发者保持稳定并穿过结果。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 触发前建立普通移动环境。
一个可见的小手势是唯一的引发原因。
触发主体保持身份和路由稳定。
最后一帧证明了旅行者和累积结果。

title: Foreground Fixation | Escalating Hazards and Task Reset
title_zh: 前景执念对抗背景灾难｜危险升级但微小任务不断线
mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult protagonist and one small repeatable foreground task in a dangerous environment. Keep the task object visible and the hands or gaze continuously recoverable while background hazards escalate through at least three distinct proximity levels. Let each hazard force only the minimum physical adjustment required for survival, then return the adult to the identical task before the next escal
mechanism_zh: 把一名明确成年原创主角和一个可重复的小型前景任务锁定在危险环境中。任务物必须持续可见，双手或视线在背景危险至少三个不同接近等级的升级过程中始终可以恢复。每次危险只迫使人物做生存所需的最小调整，随后在下一次升级前回到同一任务。把最大身体位移留给一次近接事件，但任务物不得消失或改变状态。危险过去后，结尾清楚显示成年人恢复原任务，从而证明喜剧常量是执念而不是无敌。可复用机制是前景任务持续、背景尺度升级、最小避让、一次近接峰值和立即行为复位；来源人物、面孔、盔甲、手机、战场、箭矢、火焰、准确摄影、手势、创作者身份和时间均禁止复制。
anchors: 在危险升级前，建立一名明确成年原创主角和一个可重复的小型前景任务。
让至少三种危险从背景活动逐级接近到近接，并保持方向可读。
早期只使用最小避让，并让一次近接峰值产生最大身体位移。
以成年人在危险过去后恢复原任务结束，不庆祝也不击败威胁。

title: Foreground Witness | Motion Handoff to Monument
title_zh: 见证者退场｜前景横穿到远端巨构
mechanism: A human-scale foreground witness establishes a remote monumental destination; a continuous camera drift leaves the witness, a distinct near-plane motion crosses the path, and a clear far-wide hold delivers the landscape.
mechanism_zh: A human-scale foreground witness establishes a remote monumental destination; a continuous camera drift leaves the witness, a distinct near-plane motion crosses the path, and a clear far-wide hold delivers the landscape.
anchors: 远端目标先有锚点
前景移动有独立层次
最终远景清楚交接尺度

title: Boundary Enforcement | Baseline, Interruption, Correction, Return
title_zh: 边界执行｜正式基线—干扰定位—处置—复位
mechanism: Establish a formal group setting, a stable boundary keeper and one readable baseline rule. Introduce a single localized interruption through synchronized reactions before revealing its physical source. Let the same keeper leave the anchor position, perform one attributable corrective action, then return to the repeated baseline composition with a restrained state change. The reusable mechanism is reaction-localized i
mechanism_zh: 建立正式的群体环境、稳定的边界守护者和一条可读的基线规则。在揭示其物理来源之前，通过同步反应引入单个局部中断。让同一名守门员离开锚定位置，执行一项可归因的纠正动作，然后通过限制状态变化返回到重复的基线构图。可重复使用的机制是反应局部中断、可见的执行和组合回归，而不是来源的宗教服装、教堂、电话、暴力手势或确切的笑话。
anchors: 在中断前建立一条正式的团体基线、一名边界守门员以及守门员的锚定位置。
在揭示其来源之前，通过空间连接的群反应准确定位一种干扰。
使用一项明确的、可归因的纠正措施来消除或消除源头，而不会增加第二次冲突。
将守门员放回原创的锚点并重复足够多的开场构图以证明恢复了秩序。

title: Frontal Retreat | A Collapsing Passage Forces the Only Refuge
title_zh: 正面撤退｜通道坍缩逼向唯一庇护
mechanism: Keep a retreating subject facing an advancing hazard while a camera moves backward at matched speed; progressively reduce corridor clearance along the shared axis, preserve one visible protective threshold behind the subject, then complete one crossing and boundary closure.
mechanism_zh: 让后退主体始终面对不断逼近的危险，镜头以匹配速度同步后移；沿共享轴线分阶段压缩通道空隙，并在主体身后保留唯一可见庇护入口，最后只完成一次穿越和边界闭合。
anchors: 建立一个面对威胁的主体，同时向后移动到一条可见的路线。
沿着与撤退相同的走廊轴线推进环境危害。
在最终穿越之前，在对象身后保留一个可读的保护阈值。
使用一个终端交叉口并与危险区进行明显的边界隔离。

title: Diner Alert Payoff | Phone Interruption, Coastal Travel and Calm Contrast
title_zh: 汉堡店警报兑现｜手机信息、豪车转场与海岸反差
mechanism: 从餐馆外用餐和车辆基线开始，手机警告改变人物目标；轮胎、航拍和海岸落点压缩移动过程，远端火球验证信息，人物戴上眼镜继续饮用作为克制结尾。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 从餐馆外用餐和车辆基线开始，手机警告改变人物目标；轮胎、航拍和海岸落点压缩移动过程，远端火球验证信息，人物戴上眼镜继续饮用作为克制结尾。 必须满足：一个明确的成年原创主角、手机和车辆持续存在。；一条消息重定向了路线。；旅行插入保持车辆和目的地的连续性。；警告在非图形安全距离处进行验证。；平静的最终动作与巨大的背景事件形成对比。。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 一个明确的成年原创主角、手机和车辆持续存在。
一条消息重定向了路线。
警告在非图形安全距离处进行验证。
平静的最终动作与巨大的背景事件形成对比。

title: Gesture Collection | Intangible Traces Form a Core and Rewrite the Environment
title_zh: 手势收集无形现象｜凝聚成球后释放并让环境回应
mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult subject moving through an ordinary environment with both hands visibly empty. Let the adult stop and shape one stable collection volume with both palms before any visible phenomenon appears. Draw fine related traces from at least three surrounding environmental locations toward that volume, keep them materially continuous, and compress them into one single manipulable core. Use ex
mechanism_zh: 先在普通环境中让一名明确成年原创人物展示双手为空，再用双掌形成稳定、可读的收集容器。细线、微粒或波纹只能从周边至少三处环境锚点连续汇入掌心，并压缩成一个可握持核心。人物只用一次手势沿既定轴线释放同一物质，物质随后重新分布到同一环境并留下可见回应。可复用的是空手基线、手势容器、环境汇聚、单核压缩、一次释放和环境反馈；不得复制来源人物、城市、特效形状、手势、摄影、创作者身份或时间。
anchors: 展示一位成年人，普通环境和明显空着的手在收集前。
在痕迹出现前形成一个稳定的双手收集体积。
使用一个释放手势，并在一条轴线上保持核心的材料身份。
将释放的材料重新分配到相同的环境中，并保持响应。

title: Graphic Course | Gate, Obstacles and Solo Finish
title_zh: 图形赛道｜穿越圆门、障碍升级与单人收束
mechanism: A single color-locked lead travels through a graphic environment that behaves as a course: oversized planar signs, directional graphic gates, spatial reset, denser multi-object obstacle interval and solo final poster. Preserve progressive route and graphic-to-spatial coupling, not the source typography, outfit or violence.
mechanism_zh: A single color-locked lead travels through a graphic environment that behaves as a course: oversized planar signs, directional graphic gates, spatial reset, denser multi-object obstacle interval and solo final poster. Preserve progressive route and graphic-to-spatial coupling, not the source typography, outfit or violence.
anchors: 主体身份跨空间不变
图形成为真实可走结构
终点结果与单人姿态稳定

title: Black-Orange Action Cards | Identity Reset, Tool Sweep and Hero Lockup
title_zh: 黑橙角色动作卡｜身份板复位、武器挥扫与英雄锁定
mechanism: 锁定同一成年原创动画角色的橙黑发色、服装与重型工具；白底身份板和黑橙文字场反复复位，每次只放行一个挥扫或持械姿态，终局回到完整角色板。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 锁定同一成年原创动画角色的橙黑发色、服装与重型工具；白底身份板和黑橙文字场反复复位，每次只放行一个挥扫或持械姿态，终局回到完整角色板。 必须满足：一个明确的成年原始身份保持固定。；图形重置分开证明章节。；恰好发生一次主要武器行动。；所有细节卡片映射到相同的工具几何形状。；最终英雄卡仅使用原创文案和设计。。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 一个明确的成年原始身份保持固定。
图形重置分开证明章节。
所有细节卡片映射到相同的工具几何形状。
最终英雄卡仅使用原创文案和设计。

title: Ground Caller to Aerial Formation | Carrier Selection, Boarding and Departure
title_zh: 地面召集天空编队｜近距确认、首领降落与乘骑离场
mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult ground caller, one distant aerial group and a stable terrain anchor before any close pass. Let one visible gesture, stance or nonverbal signal change the group's topology from dispersed approach to an ordered orbit or repeated route. Select one dominant carrier for a reciprocal close acknowledgment, then show its complete descent, stable landing and lowered mount posture. Keep han
mechanism_zh: 在任何近距离掠过发生前，先建立一名原创且明确成年的地面召集者、一个远处空中群体和一个稳定地形锚点。让一次可见手势、站姿或非语言信号，把群体拓扑从分散接近改为有序环绕或重复航线。选择一个主载体，通过相互近距确认建立关系，再完整展示它下降、稳定落地并降低到可登乘姿态。成年人登乘时要清楚展示手部或身体接触，只有在双方起飞并加入更大空中航线后才能结束。可复用机制是地面对天空的排序、群体对召集者的回应、载体选择、登乘和共同离场，而不是来源作品中的龙、战士、盔甲、法杖、海岸、动作编排、面孔、摄影路线、奇幻风格、音乐、创作者身份或时间安排。
anchors: 近距离掠过前，先建立一名成年地面召集者、一个远处空中群体和一个地形锚点。
用一次可见的非语言信号，把空群拓扑从分散接近改为有序环绕或固定航线。
完整展示下降、稳定落地、降低姿态和可读的登乘接触。
在登乘组合起飞并加入更大空中航线后结束。

title: Cornfield Group Halt | Numbered Route and Individual Discovery
title_zh: 群体路线个体停步｜共同奔跑、微物吸引与静场余韵
mechanism: An adult archive courier leaves a moving group to inspect a blue thread. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先用统一方向的群体运动建立强路线，再让一个成员因微小发现脱离节奏并停步；镜头从群体尺度收紧到接触细节，最终以个体凝视和空场恢复代替继续奔跑。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 在出现任何个人偏差之前，先建立一条共享的团体路线和节奏。
恰好有一个成员减速，而其余成员保持原创的方向。
详细证据重新连接到同一个人和地点。
航站楼安静的场地或过道保留了出发和发现的物理痕迹。

title: Four-Corner Field | Hand Expansion, Graphic Apex, Collapse
title_zh: 四角框域｜手势扩场、箭头峰值与收束
mechanism: A stable photoreal baseline becomes a reversible proof surface: visible hands first assign four coupled corners, a registered bounded field grows through multiple sizes while preserving the controller and environment, the largest late state gains denser directional or material information, and the same hands collapse the field to restore the baseline.
mechanism_zh: 稳定写实基线变成一块可逆验真面：清楚可见的双手先指定四个耦合角点，注册框域在保持控制者与环境不变的前提下经过多种尺寸逐级扩张；最大晚段状态增加更密集的方向或材质信息，最后由同一双手收束并恢复基线。
anchors: 激活前先建立一名明确成年原创控制者、稳定注册环境和未激活的双手。
手部几何必须先于活动角点形成，每个角或边始终绑定清楚可见的指尖或手部轨迹。
变化严格限制在注册框域内，人物身份、空间锚点和边界两侧位置不得漂移。
至少用三种框域尺寸证明同一规则；最大信息密度留到后段，再主动收束并完整回到基线。

title: Hazard Gauntlet Variant | Three-Way Countdown and Larger False-Safety Threat
title_zh: 连续脱险变体｜追车、铁轨倒计时、遮挡假安全与更大威胁
mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one pursuing threat and a readable escape axis. Add a second physical hazard from a different direction without abandoning the shared geography. Make both hazards converge through visible distance or time reduction while the subject acts within the same space. Use one large moving occluder to create a plausible but temporary safety assumption. Clear the occluder and revea
mechanism_zh: 明确成年人在共享空间关系中同时面对尾随威胁、前方障碍和侧向倒计时；一次大遮挡制造假安全，但遮挡清除后同一威胁以更大尺度或更近位置重现。 必须满足：Establish one clearly adult original subject, one pursuing threat and a readable escape axis. + Add a second physical hazard from a different direction without abandoning the shared geography. + Make both hazards converge through visible distance or time reduction while the subject acts within the same space. + Use one large moving occluder to c
anchors: 建立一个明确的成年原主体，一个追逐的威胁和一个可读的逃生轴。
从不同的方向添加第二个物理危险，同时不放弃共享的空间关系环境。
使用一个大型移动遮挡物来创造一个合理的但暂时的安全假象。
清除遮挡物并以更大的或更接近的规模揭示与同一成年人相关的保留威胁。

title: Heavy Attack vs Light Swarm | Evasion, Regrouping, Binding Reversal
title_zh: 重击对轻群体反制｜诱饵让位、群体绕行与武器缠束
mechanism: Establish two clearly adult original opponents, one heavy attack system and one light swarm system. Require the heavy attack to commit a readable path before the swarm changes formation. Make the swarm evade, preserve units and regroup behind the attack path to bind one functional point. Escalate binding through the attacker's repeated force while keeping both adult identities and geography readable. End on a stable
mechanism_zh: 先建立明确成年重型攻击者和轻量群体控制者；重击完整承诺后，轻群体避让并从攻击轨迹背后重组，逐步把进攻武器和身体缠束，最终由被反制姿态证明战术翻转。 必须满足：Establish two clearly adult original opponents, one heavy attack system and one light swarm system. + Require the heavy attack to commit a readable path before the swarm changes formation. + Make the swarm evade, preserve units and regroup behind the attack path to bind one functional point. + Escalate binding through the attacker's repeat
anchors: 建立两个明显成年的原创对手，一个重型攻击系统和一个轻量级群集系统。
要求重型攻击在群集改变阵型之前提交一个可读的路径。
通过攻击者的反复施力来升级绑定，同时保持两个成年人的身份和空间关系信息可读。
以稳定的固定画面结束，证明控制器未受伤，攻击者的原始武器仍然可识别。

title: Held Character Trailer | Gaze, Brush Title, One Action, Emblem
title_zh: 停顿型角色预告｜凝视、书法字卡、一次动作释放与徽记收束
mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult stylized character with at least three stable identity anchors in a held portrait that lasts long enough for one micro-action to matter. Replace the character once with a restrained brush or material mark carrying no more than one short exact phrase, then return to a wide environmental hold where weather or ambient motion continues but the adult waits. Release exactly one committe
mechanism_zh: 用长于常规预告剪辑的肖像停顿建立一名明确成年原创角色，并以至少三项视觉锚点保持身份。只让一次材料笔触承载一个短词，回到环境远景时让氛围移动而角色继续等待；随后仅释放一次完整身体动作并立即收住。终局以同一完整角色、一个原创名称、最多一行身份文字和单一徽记组成稳定海报。可复用的是凝视蓄力、材料字卡、远景等待、一次动作释放与徽记收束；不得复制来源角色、服装、书法、动作、片名、创作者身份或时间。
anchors: 保持一个成年人角色肖像，直到一个微动作变得显著。
使用一个克制的材料标记，最多包含一个简短的精确短语。
释放一个完全投入的全身动作，然后立即安定下来。
将固定的身份转化为一张带有名字和最多一条身份行的稳定海报。

title: Human-Scale Display Writing | Physical Stroke and Completion Proof
title_zh: 人屏同尺度书写｜既有字面、实体补笔与完成姿态
mechanism: 先建立成年人、巨型显示面和未完成文字的尺度关系，再让人物用实体书写工具沿同一表面补齐可见笔画；每次身体移动都对应一段新增墨迹，完成后离开接触点并回到全景，用人物、工具和完整原创字面共同证明结果。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先建立成年人、巨型显示面和未完成文字的尺度关系，再让人物用实体书写工具沿同一表面补齐可见笔画；每次身体移动都对应一段新增墨迹，完成后离开接触点并回到全景，用人物、工具和完整原创字面共同证明结果。 必须满足：One clearly adult operator, one fixed display and one incomplete exact text establish the baseline. + Every new stroke begins only after visible tool-to-surface contact at a registered location. + Existing letters, display frame and operator identity remain unchanged while the missing text is completed. + The tool i
anchors: 一名明显成年的操作员、一台固定显示器和一份不完整的精确文本建立了基线。
每个新笔划仅在注册位置处可见的工具与表面接触后开始。
在操作员离开书写表面之前，工具被明显释放或盖住。
最终广泛证明成人、工具和完整可读的原始消息。

title: Identity Clue Reconnection | Parts to Person
title_zh: 身份线索回连｜局部累积到主体确认
mechanism: Build one stable identity through partial but mutually consistent visual clues; after they accumulate, return to a recognizable head/face marker already glimpsed earlier. The source never supplies a final full-body proof, and the face is not fully concealed at the start. An original transfer may strengthen the closing proof without claiming the source did so.
mechanism_zh: Build one stable identity through partial but mutually consistent visual clues; after they accumulate, return to a recognizable head/face marker already glimpsed earlier. The source never supplies a final full-body proof, and the face is not fully concealed at the start. An original transfer may strengthen the closing proof without claiming the source did so.
anchors: 同一主体
局部线索相互一致
结尾回连已见标记

title: Fashion Density Reset | Identity Lock, Recap Collage, Hero Mark
title_zh: 时尚密度复位｜身份锁定、拼贴回顾与英雄主标
mechanism: A clearly adult identity remains locked while action-led foreground carriers rotate through multiple coordinated fashion-and-graphic worlds; visual density climbs to overload, abruptly resets to a sparse full-character interval, then prior states return as a compact collage recap before one simple hero wordmark closes the campaign.
mechanism_zh: 同一名明确成年角色的身份始终锁定；由动作驱动的前景载体轮转多个协调的时尚与图形世界，视觉密度逐步升至过载后突然复位到低密度完整人物段落，再以紧凑拼贴回顾此前状态，最终用一个简洁英雄主标收束广告。
anchors: 第一轮切换前先锁定一名明确成年原创角色的至少三项身份锚点，并在全部模块中保持一致。
每个造型模块至少同时改变服装、版式、道具、色彩或镜头职责中的两个通道；纯换色不算新模块。
所有模块切换都由前景物、图形边、布料或角色手势完成可见交接，并在一个峰值后插入显著低密度的完整人物段落。
复位后必须回顾至少三个此前已经出现的状态，再清场到人物、原创名称和一句主张都清楚的英雄主标。

title: Flower-Field Dance Escalation | Echo, Costume Shift, Petal Ring and Lift
title_zh: 花田舞姿升能｜分身、换装、花环与升空终拍
mechanism: 同一成年舞者在花田持续舞动，分身、彩色换装、发光花环和龙卷依次提高视觉能量；身份与地理不变，最终升空作为单一峰值。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 同一成年舞者在花田持续舞动，分身、彩色换装、发光花环和龙卷依次提高视觉能量；身份与空间关系不变，最终升空作为单一峰值。 必须满足：One clearly adult performer remains identifiable. + Every escalation is triggered by continuing choreography. + The motion echo is temporary and never replaces the lead. + Wardrobe changes once while face and body stay fixed. + Exactly one levitation peak closes the sequence.。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 一名明显的成年表演者仍可辨认。
每次升级都是由持续的编排触发的。
衣柜更换一次，脸部和身体保持固定。
恰好一个悬浮峰结束了序列。

title: Identity-Locked City Carousel | Weather, Wardrobe, and Place Change as Sets
title_zh: 同人城市天气轮转｜面部锚点不变、造型与环境成组切换
mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult traveler with at least three facial or accessory anchors, one front-facing phone distance and one repeatable address-to-camera behavior. Rotate through at least three location chapters; in each chapter vary weather, outerwear and one local tactile interaction as a coordinated set while preserving identity anchors. Verify every chapter with both one specific environment landmark class a
mechanism_zh: 用至少三项面部或服装锚点、固定自拍距离、稳定说话节奏和一个小型饰品锁定同一名明确成年原创人物。把地点、天气、外套和当地互动作为成组变量轮转，每个世界先以同一自拍关系建立，再用一次可见互动和一个地标证明；只通过遮镜、擦镜或匹配手势切入下一章。终局仍需清楚证明同一身份。此案例是既有身份锁定世界轮转模板的城市天气证据变体；不得复制来源人物、城市、服装、食物、准确转场、创作者身份或时间。
anchors: 用三个锚点锁定一个成年人的身份，保持稳定的手机距离和可重复的摄像机地址行为。
至少使用三个章节，并且在天气、外衣和一种触觉互动上进行协调。
将主要交换隐藏在一个短暂的遮挡或匹配的手势中，并恢复相同的面部比例。
在最终验证章节结束后，从同一叙述者位置拍摄。

title: Identity body jump | Upgrade of cross-land and air vehicles with the same characteristics
title_zh: 身份机体跃迁｜同一特征跨陆空载具升级
mechanism: Establish one unmistakable identity motif before any transformation, then migrate that motif through a sequence of complete mobility bodies whose functional class visibly escalates. Each stage must preserve at least two identity anchors while adding one readable new mobility affordance; do not replace one object with an unrelated one. Reserve the largest category change for the final stage and hold the completed iden
mechanism_zh: 在任何变形前先建立明确的身份母题，再让该母题依次迁移到功能等级不断提升的完整移动机体。每个阶段都必须保留至少两个身份锚点，并新增一种清晰可见的运动能力；不能用无关物体硬替换原主体。把最大的移动类别跃迁留到最后，并让完成后的身份—机体混合形态停留足够时间，以验证身份连续与新增功能。
anchors: 在机器集成开始之前，建立一个具有至少两个稳定视觉锚点的身份母题。
展示母题与第一个移动机体的物理融合，而不是剪辑成完成的替代品。
通过具有明显不同的可见运动能力的另一种移动实现来升级。
最后进行一项更大的机动性级别变更，并将身份与功能结合在一起。

title: Impact Pause | Second Entrant and Close Response
title_zh: 冲击停顿｜第二角色入场与近景确认
mechanism: A sudden localized impact pins the first agent in one geometry; a guarded pause and offscreen anticipation precede a second entrant's brief tightly bounded exchange, then a close stable view identifies the primary agent.
mechanism_zh: A sudden localized impact pins the first agent in one geometry; a guarded pause and offscreen anticipation precede a second entrant's brief tightly bounded exchange, then a close stable view identifies the primary agent.
anchors: 冲击位置清楚
第二角色在停顿后入场
主角最终身份可辨

title: Imperfect Day Memory Variant | Route, Weather Crest, Quiet Departure
title_zh: 一日记忆变体｜同一成年人物跨咖啡、交通、球场、雨夜与归途
mechanism: This is an evidence variant of the existing imperfect memory farewell. Lock one original clearly adult subject with at least three clothing, carried-object or gait anchors across at least five ordinary chapters. Use one object, route direction, weather transition or repeated movement to connect each chapter. Preserve bounded handheld imperfections—late pans, partial occlusions, focus recovery and uneven horizons—with
mechanism_zh: 同一明确成年人以服装、背包和步态贯穿一天，多个日常地点通过一个携带物、天气变化或相同运动方向接力；保留轻微构图偏差、焦点寻找和手持呼吸作为记忆质感，最后在更安静的归途淡出。作为既有复古手持日常记忆模板的新证据，不新增下拉项。 必须满足：沿用既有瑕疵记忆告别：一名明确成年原创主体以至少三项服装、携带物或步态锚点贯穿至少五个普通章节 + 每章由物件、路线方向、天气或重复动作连接 + 迟摇、遮挡、对焦恢复与斜水平等瑕疵受控且能找回主体 + 一次天气或情绪峰值后活动密度下降 + 同一成年人带至少一个锚点在安静离场或停留中结束。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 锁定一个清晰的成年原主体，至少在五个普通章节中使用三个稳定的锚点。
用一个物体、路线方向、天气变化或重复动作连接每个章节。
在减少活动密度之前放置一个天气或情感高潮。
以安静的离开结束，或者与同一位成年人保持联系，并且至少有一个锚点可见。

title: Impossible Luxury Pose | Vast Hook and Continuous Detail Ladder
title_zh: 不可能奢华姿态｜极远尺度钩子、连续推进与配饰细节阶梯
mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original luxury subject in an impossible but readable pose against measurable vast scale. Use one continuous approach or coherent lens ladder to verify the same body, outfit and environment. Allow one restrained hand action to create a small controlled accent without disturbing the pose. Give face and one primary accessory separate readable material-proof intervals. Finish on a lower-body
mechanism_zh: 以不可能但静稳的成年时装姿态作为远景钩子，持续推进依次验证脸、手中动作、主配饰与鞋履细节；环境和姿态保持连续，最终以材质特写完成奢华证明。 必须满足：Establish one clearly adult original luxury subject in an impossible but readable pose against measurable vast scale. + Use one continuous approach or coherent lens ladder to verify the same body, outfit and environment. + Allow one restrained hand action to create a small controlled accent without disturbing the pose. + Give face and one prim
anchors: 建立一个清晰的成年人原版奢侈品主体，以一种不可能但可读的姿态，面对可测量的广阔规模。
使用一种连续的方法或连贯的镜头阶梯来验证同一主体、服装和环境。
为面部和一个主要配饰提供独立的可读材料证明间隔。
以低角度或产品特写结束，保持相同的光线和环境，而不是切换到不相关的包装照。

title: Impossible Task Reframe | Failed Pull to Whole-Base Lift
title_zh: 不可能任务改解｜受阻尝试、整体抬起与见证反应
mechanism: 先建立物件与底座不可分的挑战规则，角色完成一次失败尝试；随后不改变规则而改用整体抬起的解决方式，独立见证者用近景反应确认反差。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先建立物件与底座不可分的挑战规则，角色完成一次失败尝试；随后不改变规则而改用整体抬起的解决方式，独立见证者用近景反应确认反差。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 物件与底座始终不分离
常规方法先明确失败
见证者确认反常解法

title: Industrial Carrier Failure | Sea Displacement, Bridge Reaction, Port Aftermath
title_zh: 工业载体失控｜海面异常、驾驶反应与港区余波
mechanism: An ice freighter transfers a shelf-collapse consequence from channel to pier. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 用一个稳定工业载体建立尺度，再让不可控介质从船体传播到驾驶舱和港区；每次切换都保留同一事故方向，终局以陆地残留证明影响跨域。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 一个产业载体建立规模和库存。
外部介质导致每一次位移。
空间关系在外部和内部剪辑中仍然可以恢复。
最终的岸边状态保留了可见的结果和源载体。

title: Dual Responsibilities | Independent Work, Shared Outcome
title_zh: 双角色职责｜独立建立后共同完成
mechanism: Establish two distinct characters through separate, observable responsibilities before they interact. Give each one stable identity, tool, local action and intermediate result; only after both roles are independently legible may they meet at one shared interface where both contributions are required. End on a concrete joint result that could not exist if either role were removed, while preserving both identities.
mechanism_zh: 在互动前分别用可观察的职责建立两个不同角色：每个角色都有稳定身份、专属工具、局部动作和中间结果。只有双方都已独立清楚，才让他们在一个需要两边共同贡献的共享接口相遇。最终成果必须具体可见、缺少任一方都无法成立，并继续保留双方身份。
anchors: 通过一个稳定的工具、本地操作和可见的中间结果来建立角色A。
在本地操作完成时保持角色 A 的身份和结果清晰。
将这两个角色带到一个共享界面，其中每个贡献都是明显需要的。
保持具体的联合结果，同时保留身份、工具和互补的责任。

title: Miniature Table Mission | Tactical Route, Giant Food Retrieval and Hand Reveal
title_zh: 微缩队伍餐桌任务｜环境巨物、绳索协作与人手中断
mechanism: 以餐桌常物建立巨大尺度，三名成年微缩队员从地图规划、绳索滑行、攀爬吸管到捆绑薯条依次协作；真实人手只在终局进入一次，打断他们的成果并证明尺度关系。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 以餐桌常物建立巨大尺度，三名成年微缩队员从地图规划、绳索滑行、攀爬吸管到捆绑薯条依次协作；真实人手只在终局进入一次，打断他们的成果并证明尺度关系。 必须满足：Exactly three clearly adult miniature workers retain identity and scale. + Each task step uses visible tools and contact. + The giant table geography remains continuous. + A full-size hand enters only once at the terminal interruption. + The slack rope proves the direct consequence of the removed object.。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和
anchors: 恰好三个明显成年的小型工作者保持身份和比例。
每个任务步骤使用可见的工具和接触。
完整的手只在终端中断时进入一次。
松弛绳证明了移除对象的直接后果。

title: Input-to-Result Loop | Controls, Response, Outcome, Human Reaction
title_zh: 输入—屏幕—结果—反应｜实体操作与虚拟反馈逐拍闭环
mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult operator, a physical input device and a visible response display in the same geography. For every important virtual event, show one specific physical input first, then the corresponding screen or machine response, then a readable operator reaction when appropriate. Escalate from selection through locomotion and defense to one decisive result. Reconnect the result to the same adult
mechanism_zh: 先建立成年玩家、实体控制器和屏幕同框关系；每个虚拟动作前必须先看见一次具体输入，屏幕反馈随后发生，玩家再给出清楚可辨的人物反应。用选角、移动、反击和胜负四级闭环升级，终局只确认结果与人物，不补写来源中未出现的再开一局。 必须满足：明确成年原创操作者、实体输入设备和响应屏幕或机器同一空间关系先建立 + 每个重要虚拟或机械事件前先展示一个具体物理输入 + 至少三组不同输入—响应对应且输出不得提前 + 从选择、导航或防御升级到一个决定性结果 + 终局把结果重新连接到同一成年人物的清楚可辨的人物反应。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 建立一个明确的成年人操作员、物理控制和响应显示。
在匹配的虚拟响应之前展示每个重要的物理输入。
从设置和导航升级到一个决定性的结果状态。
以重新连接结果并引发同一人物清楚可辨的反应来结束。

title: AI Interface Portfolio | Capability Inputs and Result Montage
title_zh: 界面能力证明蒙太奇｜输入、工具、生成结果与复盘回标
mechanism: A research workspace proves query, source, analysis, local-tool and audit capabilities. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 把同一软件的输入框、工具菜单、数据收集、媒体结果、插件连接和错误复盘压缩为多个可验证章节；每个章节都先显示操作再显示结果，终局回到统一产品主张而非随机拼贴。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 一个持久的产品界面和视觉系统锚定了所有功能章节。
每章都会在相应结果之前显示用户操作。
后来的工具重用早期的查询上下文并公开可追踪的源或错误证据。
最终命题总结了演示的链并重新连接到原始输入表面。

title: Interface Boundary Recovery | Displacement and Reset
title_zh: 界面角色触发扰动｜生理动作、图标失序与恢复
mechanism: 同一界面扰动机制的第二证据：角色的一次喷嚏使固定图标偏移，人物跨越界面边界回收元素，终局恢复原有工作关系并保留轻微事故痕迹。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 同一界面扰动机制的第二证据：角色的一次喷嚏使固定图标偏移，人物跨越界面边界回收元素，终局恢复原有工作关系并保留轻微事故痕迹。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 先建立稳定界面
一次触发导致全部偏移
同一角色恢复并保留轻微痕迹

title: Impact Aftermath | Private Dilemma to City-Scale Cause
title_zh: 冲击后揭示｜从私密困境到城市尺度真因
mechanism: Begin inside a tight protected or confined relationship, let one immense external force abruptly displace the carrier, prove impact and disorientation locally, hold a survivor reaction long enough to register consequence, then widen to reveal the much larger environmental cause and aftermath.
mechanism_zh: 从亲密、受保护或受限制的关系状态开始，让一股巨大外力突然推动既定载体；用局部撞击与失衡证明影响，并让幸存者反应停留到后果清楚可读，最后拉宽视野揭示更大尺度的环境原因及其影响。
anchors: 在大型活动之前从亲密的有限基线开始。
让一种外力明显取代既定的载体。
运动停止后保持一次撞击后反应。
只有在局部后果明确后才揭示更大的原因。

title: Invisible Boundary Proof | Impact, Retest and Rerouting
title_zh: 不可见边界验真｜碰撞、手测与改道离开
mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult traveler, one simple route and a stable camera axis that makes the space ahead look fully passable. Let the adult approach continuously until exactly one unseen boundary contact produces a readable full-body stop or recoil; preserve the approach, contact and consequence without a cut across the causal moment. Show one brief self-check on the affected body area, then return to the
mechanism_zh: 先建立一名明确成年原创行进者、一条简单路线和一个稳定摄影轴线，让前方空间看起来完全可通行。成年人持续接近，直到唯一一次不可见边界接触造成清楚的全身骤停或回弹；接近、接触和后果之间不得切断。先对受影响身体部位做一次简短自检，再回到准确接触位置进行一次受控手掌复测。边界只能通过压力、冷凝、粒子或涟漪等局部物理证据显形，整体表面仍须透明。结尾由成年人作出明确改道决定并离开受阻轴线，边界空间位置保持稳定。可复用机制是假通行预期、一次撞击、身体证据、主动复测、不可见平面局部证明和路线修正；来源角色、面孔、发型、服装、走廊、魔法配件、涟漪设计、准确手势、构图、水印、创作者身份和时间均禁止复制。
anchors: 建立一名明确成年原创行进者、一条简单路线和一个稳定轴线，让画面清楚预示可以自由通过。
只使用一次不间断不可见接触，并保留接近、接触和身体回弹。
回到同一位置只做一次受控手掌测试，并把边界反应限制在接触周围。
以明确改道决定结束，同时确认过的边界固定在原路线。

title: Irreversible Process Chain | Material States to Human Proof
title_zh: 不可逆烹饪状态链｜食材、工具、锅体、成品与品尝连续证明
mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult cook, one kitchen, one main ingredient set, one primary vessel and visible hand or tool anchors. Build at least five irreversible food states; each beat performs one clear operation and leaves visible residue, shape, color, steam or container continuity that becomes input for the next beat. Do not jump backward to whole ingredients after they are cut or cooked. Keep the same serving th
mechanism_zh: 同一明确成年厨师、厨房、主食材与关键工具持续锁定，每镜只推动一次不可逆食品状态变化，并让上一状态残留成为下一步原料；用颜色、容器和手部锚点防止食材跳变。成品装盘后必须由同一人物完成一次克制品尝。 必须满足：一名明确成年原创操作者、固定空间、主材料组、主要容器与手部或工具锚点先建立 + 至少五个不可逆状态且每镜只执行一次清楚操作 + 上一状态的残留、形状、颜色、蒸汽或容器连续成为下一步输入 + 不得回到已消失的早期状态并保持数量合理 + 同一成品由同一成年人完成一次克制使用或品尝证明。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 锁定一个清晰的成年厨师，厨房，食材套装，主要容器和手或工具锚。
每拍执行一个不可逆的操作，并将可见残留物保留到下一步。
通过烹饪和摆盘保持食物颜色、数量和容器转换的合理。
以同样的装盘和一个由同一位成年人控制的味道结束。

title: Kinetic Text | Barriers Shatter in Sequence
title_zh: 动力短片｜文字障碍逐个击碎
mechanism: Begin in a visually suppressed world, bind one short word or phrase to a physical obstacle in the subject's route, and require the subject's forward action to break that obstacle rather than merely passing it. Each break restores a visible part of the world; finish with one original concise statement that names the achieved state, not the source slogan.
mechanism_zh: 从一个视觉压抑的世界开始，将一个简短的单词或短语与主体路线上的物理障碍绑定，并要求主体采取向前行动来打破该障碍，而不仅仅是通过它。每次打破都会恢复世界可见的部分；以一个原创的简洁陈述结束，指出所达到的状态，而不是源口号。
anchors: 开场先建立受抑制环境状态
短词必须占据真实路线空间
障碍只能由主角前进动作击碎
每次击碎恢复可见环境状态
结尾只用一个原创短句命名结果

title: Character Profile | Ability Layering
title_zh: 人物档案｜能力逐层点亮
mechanism: Hold one subject and one modular information grid completely stable while a dossier boots from absence to completeness in a strict hierarchy. Each phase activates a new semantic layer—identity, role, diagnostics, capability, equipment and status—while the subject performs only micro-motion. Information order, not camera travel, creates retention; subject, domain, panel geometry, palette and labels are variable.
mechanism_zh: 让一个主体和一套模块化信息网格完全稳定，一份档案按严格层级从空白启动到完整。各阶段依次激活身份、角色、诊断、能力、装备与状态，而主体只做微动作。观众留存与注意维持来自信息顺序而非镜头移动；主体、领域、面板几何、配色与标签均可替换。
anchors: 人物身份稳定
档案框架固定
信息层级按功能递进
终态是可执行的待命状态

title: Quadrant Type System | Touch Trigger, Panel Relay and Phone Lockup
title_zh: 四象限字形系统｜触点启动、分栏接力与手机锁定
mechanism: 固定黑、奶油、薄荷、橙红四色与四象限网格，手指触点启动图标和字块；分栏、推移、旋转与唱片式圆环逐步合并，最终在手机框中锁定完整原创短句。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 固定黑、奶油、薄荷、橙红四色与四象限网格，手指触点启动图标和字块；分栏、推移、旋转与唱片式圆环逐步合并，最终在手机框中锁定完整原创短句。 必须满足：一个固定的四色系统持续存在。；一个单独的强调点启动序列。；每个细胞的转变遵循相同的节奏。；字母组合在崩溃前仍然可读。；最终锁定仅包含原始副本并保留早期的几何形状。。只迁移抽象机制；来源人物、地点、品牌、文字、道具造型、精确动作、构图和时间均不得复制。
anchors: 一个固定的四色系统持续存在。
一个单独的强调点启动序列。
字母组合在崩溃前仍然可读。
最终锁定仅包含原始副本并保留早期的几何形状。

title: Material Word Reveal | Collision, Readable Hold, Dissolve
title_zh: 切线成字｜材料变化与可读停留
mechanism: 两股同材质载体先分离、再沿清楚路径碰撞，物质在冲击后凝成原创短词并停留可读；结尾让字标按同一材质规则散回环境。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 两股同材质载体先分离、再沿清楚路径碰撞，物质在冲击后凝成原创短词并停留可读；结尾让字标按同一材质规则散回环境。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 操作与材料反应同框
字形由同一材料形成
可读停留与后续终态分开

title: Linear Threat Redirection | Contact, Bend, Residue
title_zh: 直线威胁改道｜接触截获、轨迹弯折与残留确认
mechanism: 先建立攻击者、目标与直线威胁路径，被攻击者必须在可见接触点截获能量并连续弯折轨迹；威胁离开目标后以烟尘或灼痕证明改道结果。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 先建立攻击者、目标与直线威胁路径，被攻击者必须在可见接触点截获能量并连续弯折轨迹；威胁离开目标后以烟尘或灼痕证明改道结果。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
anchors: 威胁先形成清楚直线路径
改道从可见接触点开始
新轨迹与残留共同证明结果

title: Flat Soda Impact Ad | Registered Can, Fizzy Contact, Wordmark Return
title_zh: 汽水平面冲击广告｜罐体锚定、气泡撞击与字标归位

Preserve the five causal invariants, stable spatial anchors and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.

每个图形突发都从可见的打包动作开始。
文案在移动过程中保持简短且可读。
所有元素返回完整产品锁定状态。

title: Micro-Contact Activates Megastructure | Glyph Trigger, Concentric Expansion, Portal Reveal
title_zh: 微小接触激活巨构｜符号点亮、同心扩展与空间门户
mechanism: A contour disk expands into a suspended terrain sphere after one traced notch. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.

anchors: 一个有界对象建立非活动基线。
一个可见的触点是唯一的触发器。
成人和起源标记保留了规模和空间关系。
终端框架保存原点、变换环境和反应。

title: Material Guide | Spatial Growth Resolves into a Flat Layout
title_zh: 材质引路｜空间生长到版式定格
mechanism: Begin with one small material guide aligned to a stable subject. Keep that same material visually continuous as it pulls the camera, accumulates color and depth, becomes one readable physical structure, and expands into an inhabitable environment. Reserve one final camera rise that compresses the dimensional world into a held graphic sheet while preserving the subject and material history.
mechanism_zh: 从与稳定主体对齐的微小材质引导物开始，让同一材质持续牵引镜头、积累颜色与深度、形成可辨实体结构并扩展成可进入的环境；最后只进行一次俯拍升高，把立体世界压缩为保留人物与材质关系的平面版式。
anchors: 在同一光轴上引入一个小型材料导轨作为稳定主体。
保持一个连续的材质系列负责相机引导、颜色积累和空间增长。
将相同的材质扩展到仍包含原始主体和先前调色板的环境中。
使用后期摄像机升起将立体场景解析为保留主体和材料历史的保留图形表。

title: Noir Detective Credits | Comic Evidence Grid and Master-Title Resolution
title_zh: 黑色侦探片头｜唱片母题、案件拼贴与总标题归拢
mechanism: 以旋转唱片和侦探剪影建立母题，再让列车、便签、人物剪影和案件标签进入统一蓝橙紫漫画格；职员表与物证共用版式，终局归拢成可读总标题。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 以旋转唱片和侦探剪影建立母题，再让列车、便签、人物剪影和案件标签进入统一蓝橙紫漫画格；职员表与物证共用版式，终局归拢成可读总标题。 必须满足：One recurring evidence carrier opens the title system and remains traceable. + Every vignette uses the same limited palette and registered comic grid. + Credits are exact original text and occupy bounded readable regions. + Connections between clues remain visually causal rather than decorative clutter. + The master title contains miniature residu
anchors: 一个反复出现的证据载体打开标题系统并保持可追踪性。
每个短片都使用相同的有限调色板和注册漫画网格。
线索之间的连接保持视觉上的因果关系，而不是装饰性的杂乱。
主标题包含早期证据模块的微小残留。

title: Quiet Writing Progress Clock | Line Advance, Ink Reset, Seamless Resumption
title_zh: 安静书写进度钟｜落笔推进、蘸墨复位与无缝续写
mechanism: A map archivist resumes green route lines after one ink reset. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 用固定书桌、同一成年书写者、笔尖位置和已写行数形成进度钟；墨量下降触发一次蘸墨，笔尖必须回到原停止位置之后继续，最终以新增行证明任务前进。 可复用机制保留因果顺序、空间锚点和终态证明，同时替换来源特有的人物、地点、对象、措辞、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 一个工作空间、成年工人和工具保持固定。
可见的进步是单调累积的。
工具将在之前的确切停止点之外恢复。
终端框架证明了额外的已完成工作。

title: Miniaturized Levels | Material Morphing
title_zh: 微缩闯关｜同一材质连续变形
mechanism: Establish one tiny protagonist crossing a single oversized terrain, then make that same substrate change physical role in a causal ladder: reliable footing becomes resistance, resistance becomes an improvised carrier, and the carrier becomes an elastic transition. Only after the protagonist has attempted those states, introduce one full-scale tool exactly once as a final bridge. End with the protagonist back in a sta
mechanism_zh: 先建立一个正在穿越单一超大地形的微小主角，再让同一种基质沿因果阶梯改变物理职责：可靠落脚面变成阻力，阻力变成临时载体，载体再变成弹性过渡。只有主角亲自经历这些状态后，才允许一个全尺寸工具进入一次，充当最后的桥接。结尾让主角回到稳定、自主的姿态，使尺度差带来的外部协助解决路线问题，却不夺走角色的主动权。
anchors: 开场先证明主体与地形尺度
同一材质至少承担三种连续物理角色
每次解决动作必须引出下一个材质状态
外部尺度工具只在后段进入一次
结尾主体恢复自主稳定状态

title: Liquid-Chrome Word Loop | Aggregation, Exact Hold, Dissolution
title_zh: 液态铬字凝聚｜水滴汇流、字形锁定与粒子消散
mechanism: Amber glass droplets form TIDAL and return to the opening field. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface. The reusable mechanism retains causal order and evidence duties while replacing source identity, setting, wording, objects, choreography and design.
mechanism_zh: 琥珀色玻璃液滴逐步汇聚形成 TIDAL，并最终回到开场场域。保留五项因果不变量与终态证明，同时替换所有来源特有的表层元素。可复用机制保留因果顺序和证据职责，同时替换来源身份、场景、措辞、对象、动作编排与设计。
anchors: 一种材料系列和一种定向流驱动每个阶段。
质量聚合在字母形成之前保持单调。
版式几何形状在按住期间保持稳定。
最终溶解使材料返回开放场和颗粒尺度。

title: Constructed Character Reveal | Wire, Clay, Wardrobe and Living Finish
title_zh: 手工半身像装配｜骨架、覆泥、服装与真人化终态
